decisions.reason: As a flagship line close to the firm's core safety-footwear capabilities, in a growing industry with in-house R&D and likely some slack, management would usually tolerate uncertain early results and keep it unless performance clearly fell below aspiration.

Because this electrostatic-dissipative shoe is still close to the established offer but appears more niche and less central than a flagship range, management would keep it for now yet be more willing to reallocate resources if its sales stayed below aspiration.

A multi-model safety shoe series fits the firm's broad product logic and core competences, so absent clear evidence of persistent underperformance the behavioral-theory expectation is continued support rather than withdrawal.
